We're about to ship VectorCraft Pro 2.3 and our legal team needs a complete, production-ready End User License Agreement for it before launch. I've put together a product brief at docs/legal/product_brief.txt with all the commercial details (licensing model, pricing, platforms, jurisdiction, etc.). There's also an old incomplete fragment in docs/legal/drafts/ that someone started — do NOT use it, it's missing critical sections.

Please draft the full EULA as a file named `eula_draft.md`. It needs to cover everything a proper software EULA requires — license grant, restrictions, intellectual property, liability, termination, and enforceability — all tailored to our specific product details from the brief. Make sure it's comprehensive enough to pass a legal completeness review.
